universal_rules.rule: Q-hook as TITLE LEAD loses across all lanes
universal_rules.action: Never open the title with a question. Q-hook energy belongs in the thumbnail.

universal_rules.rule: Q-hook as THUMBNAIL wins in anxiety/relaxation/cognitive lanes
universal_rules.action: Use Q-hook in thumb for anxiety, relaxation, overthinking, cognitive-clarity lanes.
Default to 3 slots. Never stuff Hz, wave type, or jargon into title.
Always use specific thumb text. Generic soft descriptors never win.

universal_rules.rule: Higher VidIQ score wins within same title category
universal_rules.action: When choosing between two SEO leads in the same lane, pick the higher VidIQ score.

universal_rules.rule: IFO format (Instrument-for-Outcome) is format-tolerant, not a winning formula
universal_rules.action: IFO ties but doesn't win. Use when no better option, not as default.
